department: Neuroscience Graduate Program (NSP, School of Medicine / Graduate School)

deadline.value: International priority deadline is November 1, 2026 (first-consideration deadline December 1, 2026; Thesis Lab Track applicants must contact Program Directors by November 1).
deadline.quote: PRIORITY DEADLINE FOR INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS IS NOVEMBER 1. | Applications to the Neuroscience Program received by December 1 will be given first consideration for admission to the Fall Semester of the following year.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required or considered in application review.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required or considered in the review of applications.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists specifically for Neuroscience, and the GRE is not required or considered.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is not required or considered in the review of applications.

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admitted students default to the Rotation Track (3 lab rotations before selecting a thesis lab at the end of year one); a limited Thesis Lab Track requires prior mentor relationship and contacting Program Directors by Nov 1.
supervisor.quote: Rotation Track – Incoming students will do 3 rotations in Neuroscience labs and select a thesis lab at the end of their first year. This is the default track and the significant majority of students are expected to enter through this track.

funding.value: PhD students receive coverage of stipend, tuition, and fees including health insurance.
funding.quote: Students in our doctoral program receive coverage of stipend, tuition, and fees (including health insurance).

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's degree or equivalent (baccalaureate in biological science, chemistry, physics, or engineering recommended).
entry_route.quote: An undergraduate degree or its equivalent is required. A baccalaureate degree in a biological science, chemistry, physics or engineering is recommended.

notes: Admits 7–11 students per fall into the Rotation Track or limited Thesis Lab Track; students can also enter via BSP umbrella or MD/PhD MSTP.
